method.operation: mask-aware overlapping patch quilting from the same cropped RGB frame
method.lighting_and_specular_handling: Inherited from the Appendix300 source image and current quilting implementation; not intrinsic-albedo recovery

definitions.autocorrelation: Pearson correlation of grayscale atlas pixels and a horizontally shifted copy at the listed offset; this is a narrow periodicity diagnostic, not a realism score
definitions.boundary_to_global_gradient_ratio: mean grayscale gradient across quilting grid boundaries divided by the overall horizontal grayscale gradient; near 1 means no exceptional grid-boundary jump under this statistic
definitions.highpass_rms_sigma2: RMS of grayscale atlas minus Gaussian blur with sigma 2 px

diagnostics.selection_reason: Among the tested variants, the 80 px patch has the lowest measured correlation at its own quilting stride (0.24848 versus 0.42828 for 48 px); larger patches show stronger long-offset repetition in these diagnostics. This heuristic does not demonstrate improved anatomical realism.
